# Does your redirect chain loop, run too long, or dead-end?

> Free tool: paste the hops a URL's redirects actually took (from your browser's Network tab, or a curl -sI trace) and check for a redirect loop, a chain longer than the recommended single hop, an HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrade, a permanent site move using a temporary status code, and a chain that dead-ends in a 404 or 500.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
